newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila prequalifies 3 bidders for PNB unit.
newsitem.headline: Manila prequalifies 3 bidders for PNB unit.

text.p: The Philippine Monetary Board prequalified three groups to bid for a 60 percent stake in PNB-Republic Bank, Central Bank deputy governor Alberto Reyes said on Tuesday. They were: Malayan Banking Berhad, Equitable Banking Corp and a group led by former banker Francisco Dizon, he said.
PNB-Republic Bank is a unit of Philippine National Bank.

In prequalifying the interested bidders, the Central Bank looked at the capability of the groups to put up the amount of capital needed to participate in the bidding and who those groups are, Reyes said.
The floor price set for the PNB stake was 800 million pesos.
Separately, PNB executive vice president Valentin Araneta said the three prequalified groups would have until December 23 to submit their offers.
